title: HOLogicBench: Evaluating Higher-Order Logical Reasoning in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2606.23238v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing LLM logical-reasoning benchmarks largely focus on object-level inference under fixed predicates and rules, leaving higher-order reasoning over rules and policies underexplored. We introduce HOLogicBench, a 1,379-instance benchmark that systematically evaluates five representative higher-order reasoning operations, with Isabelle/HOL formalizations and proof-verified answers. Beyond answer accuracy, HOLogicBench provides solver-verified reference reasoning paths for each instance, enabling fine-grained evaluation of model-generated reasoning against valid derivations. Across 16 model configurations, average accuracy is 53.86\%, with the best configuration reaching 65.99\%. Further analyses reveal that LLMs exhibit limited alignment with valid derivations, remain vulnerable to minimal counterfactual perturbations, and display distinct failure patterns across higher-order reasoning types.

translated_title: HOLogicBench：评估大语言模型中的高阶逻辑推理能力
translated_abstract: 现有的大语言模型逻辑推理基准主要聚焦于在固定谓词和规则下的对象级推理，而对规则和策略的高阶推理研究仍然不足。我们提出了HOLogicBench，一个包含1,379个实例的基准，系统性评估五种代表性的高阶推理操作，并采用Isabelle/HOL形式化表示和经证明验证的答案。除了答案准确率之外，HOLogicBench还为每个实例提供了由求解器验证的参考推理路径，从而能够对模型生成的推理与有效推导进行细粒度评估。在16个模型配置中，平均准确率为53.86%，最佳配置达到65.99%。进一步分析表明，大语言模型与有效推导的对齐程度有限，面对最小的反事实扰动时依然脆弱，并且在不同高阶推理类型上呈现出不同的失败模式。
tldr: 本文提出HOLogicBench基准，包含1,379个经Isabelle/HOL形式化证明验证的实例，系统性评估大语言模型在五种高阶逻辑推理操作上的能力，发现现有模型平均准确率仅为53.86%，且推理路径与有效推导对齐不足、易受最小反事实扰动的影响。
en_tdlr: HOLogicBench is a 1,379-instance benchmark with Isabelle/HOL proof-verified answers and solver-verified reasoning paths that systematically evaluates five higher-order reasoning operations in LLMs, revealing that models achieve only 53.86% average accuracy, show limited alignment with valid derivations, and remain vulnerable to minimal counterfactual perturbations.
